stories.title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world
stories.brief: Interests of oil-producing countries, a US boycott and a dispute over finance may have torpedoed climate talks.

stories.title: 'Carrying hopes of 250m people': Zeeshan Ali to be first Pakistani in space aboard China's Shenzhou-24
stories.brief: Zeeshan Ali was named a crew member of China’s Shenzhou-24 space mission on Tuesday, which is scheduled to launch on November 25, with Ali set to become the first Pakistani to undertake an orbital space mission.

stories.title: Zeeshan Ali to be Pakistan's first astronaut in space aboard Shenzhou-24
stories.brief: Pakistan's Muhammad Zeeshan Ali is set to become the first foreign astronaut to visit China's Tiangong space station, joining the Shenzhou-24 mission crew scheduled to launch on Wednesday, the China Manned Space Agency (CMSA) on Tuesday.

stories.title: Opp turns to courts over Imran's safety
stories.brief: Both leaders have maintained that when the executive disregards the Constitution and court orders, it becomes their constitutional duty to bring the matter before the chief justices.

stories.title: ‘Rights at stake, not privileges’: Opposition leaders write to SC, FCC, IHC chief justices on Imran, Bushra’s health
stories.brief: In an open letter to the same three judges last week, Imran appealed for medical treatment for himself and Bushra Bibi.

stories.title: Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO after Trump intervenes

stories.brief: The jump in Nvidia shares has also lifted stock markets, with the tech-heavy Nasdaq up 6.5%.
